name: Redis 8 with RedisInsight UI and Persistence
description: Password-protected Redis 8 with JSON, Search, persistence and a web UI.

upstream.redis: redis:8.10.3 (official image, Debian trixie, Redis Open Source 8.10.3 with RediSearch 8.10.1, RedisJSON 8.10.0, RedisTimeSeries 8.10.1, RedisBloom 8.10.1; image built 2026-10-28)

Redis.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -eu; D="${RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH:-/data}"; D="${D%/}"; C=/etc/redis-railway; F="$C/redis.conf"; log() { echo "redis-railway: $*"; }; num() { case "$1" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "$2" ;; *) echo "$1" ;; esac; }; low() { echo "$1" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]"; }; w() { echo "$*" >> "$F"; }; P="${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}"; R="^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{16,}$"; if [[ ! "$P" =~ $R ]]; then log "REDIS_PASSWORD needs 16+ characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -"; exit 1; fi; H=$(( $(num "$(grep -m 1 MemTotal /proc/meminfo | tr -s " " | cut -d " " -f 2)" 1048576) * 1024 )); L=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo max); L=$(num "$L" "$H"); if [ "$L" -gt "$H" ]; then L=$H; fi; MM=$(low "${REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-auto}"); PCT=$(num "${REDIS_MAXMEMORY_PERCENT:-75}" 75); if [ "$PCT" -lt 10 ] || [ "$PCT" -gt 95 ]; then PCT=75; fi; R="^[0-9]+([kmg]b?)?$"; if [ -z "$MM" ] || [ "$MM" = auto ]; then MM=$(( L / 100 * PCT )); MS="${PCT}% of ${L}"; elif [[ "$MM" =~ $R ]]; then MS=REDIS_MAXMEMORY; else log "REDIS_MAXMEMORY must be auto, 0 or a size like 512mb"; exit 1; fi; AOF=$(low "${REDIS_APPENDONLY:-yes}"); case "$AOF" in yes|true|on|1) AOF=yes ;; *) AOF=no ;; esac; SAVE=$(low "${REDIS_SAVE-3600 1 300 100 60 10000}"); case "$SAVE" in off|none|no|false) SAVE="" ;; esac; R="^[0-9 ]*$"; if [[ ! "$SAVE" =~ $R ]]; then log "REDIS_SAVE must be seconds/changes pairs or off"; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$D"; rm -rf "$D/lost+found"; cd "$D"; M="$D/.railway-appendonly"; PRE=""; if [ "$AOF" = yes ] && [ -s dump.rdb ] && { [ ! -d appendonlydir ] || [ "$(cat "$M" 2>/dev/null || true)" = no ]; }; then if [ -d appendonlydir ]; then rm -rf appendonlydir.stale-*; mv appendonlydir "appendonlydir.stale-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"; fi; PRE="preload-file rdb:$D/dump.rdb"; log "AOF was off: loading dump.rdb once to build the AOF"; fi; echo "$AOF" > "$M"; chown -R redis:redis "$D"; umask 077; mkdir -p "$C"; : > "$F"; w "bind * -::*"; w "protected-mode yes"; w "requirepass $P"; w "dir $D"; w "appendonly $AOF"; w "appendfsync $(low "${REDIS_APPENDFSYNC:-everysec}")"; if [ -n "$SAVE" ]; then w "save $SAVE"; fi; if [ -n "$PRE" ]; then w "$PRE"; fi; w "maxmemory $MM"; w "maxmemory-policy $(low "${REDIS_MAXMEMORY_POLICY:-noeviction}")"; w "enable-protected-configs no"; w "enable-debug-command no"; w "enable-module-command no"; if [ -n "${REDIS_EXTRA_CONFIG:-}" ]; then echo "$REDIS_EXTRA_CONFIG" >> "$F"; fi; chown -R redis:redis "$C"; export SKIP_FIX_PERMS=1; log "maxmemory $MM ($MS), appendonly $AOF, save ${SAVE:-off}, dir $D"; if [ -z "$SAVE" ]; then exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server "$F" --save ""; fi; exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server "$F"'

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Password of the default user, generated at deploy (letters only, URL-safe). Required by every connection, private and public.

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name.

REDISUSER.description: Redis user for clients (the built-in default user).

REDISHOST.description: Private hostname of this service (redis.railway.internal), reachable only from services in the same environment.

REDISPORT.description: Port Redis listens on (IPv4 and IPv6).

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string over the private network. Reference it from other services as ${{Redis.REDIS_URL}}.

REDIS_PUBLIC_URL.description: Connection string through the public TCP proxy (no TLS, egress-billed). Empty if the proxy is removed.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY.description: Memory cap. auto = REDIS_MAXMEMORY_PERCENT of the container limit; or a size like 256mb / 2gb; 0 = no cap.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY_PERCENT.description: Share of the container memory limit used by auto (10-95). The rest is headroom for fork during RDB/AOF rewrites.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY_POLICY.description: What happens at the cap. noeviction = refuse writes (stores, queues). allkeys-lru / allkeys-lfu = evict (caches).

REDIS_APPENDONLY.description: yes = append-only file (AOF) persistence on the volume. no = RDB snapshots only (or nothing if REDIS_SAVE=off).

REDIS_APPENDFSYNC.description: AOF fsync policy: everysec (at most ~1 s of writes lost on a crash), always (slow, safest) or no.

REDIS_SAVE.description: RDB snapshot points as 'seconds changes' pairs (Redis defaults). off = no RDB snapshots.

REDIS_EXTRA_CONFIG.description: Extra redis.conf lines appended last, one directive per line (raw editor), e.g. ACL users or io-threads 4.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Redis gets after SIGTERM to write its final snapshot and fsync the AOF on redeploy.

PORT.description: Port Railway's healthcheck probes (/api/health); must match RI_APP_PORT.

RI_APP_HOST.description: Listen on all IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (Railway's private network can resolve to IPv6).

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Run as root so RedisInsight can write the root-owned Railway volume at /data (the image's user is node).

RI_REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Preconfigured database: Redis password (follows the Redis service by reference).

RI_REDIS_ALIAS.description: Name of the preconfigured database in RedisInsight's list.

RI_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the passwords RedisInsight stores in /data. Do not change it later (stored passwords become unreadable).

RI_ACCEPT_TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS.description: false = you accept RedisInsight's terms in the UI on first visit. true = accepted for you, analytics and notifications off.

RI_DATABASE_MANAGEMENT.description: true = databases can be added and edited in the UI. false = only the preconfigured Redis is shown.

RI_STDOUT_LOGGER.description: Log to stdout so logs show in Railway.

RI_FILES_LOGGER.description: No log files on the volume (they would grow without bound).

PORT.description: Port the gateway listens on; Railway's healthcheck probes /healthz here.

BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Login password for RedisInsight, generated at deploy (16+ characters). Hashed with bcrypt at start.

REDISINSIGHT_UPSTREAM.description: RedisInsight on the private network; the gateway is its only public entry point.

REDISINSIGHT_URL.description: Public URL of RedisInsight (log in with BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME / BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD).

REDIS_USER.description: Redis user (needs SYNC for redis-cli --rdb; the default user has it).

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Redis password (follows the Redis service by reference).

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Keep false: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style URLs. true only for buckets whose Credentials tab says path-style.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for Redis to answer PING before failing.

BACKUP_WORK_DIR.description: Scratch directory for the snapshot (needs free space of about the RDB size).

BACKUP_RESTORE_RUN.description: Set to a run folder (e.g. 20261031T032000Z) to REPLACE all Redis data with that backup on the next run. Clear afterwards.

BACKUP_RESTORE_PORT.description: Port of the temporary restore server inside this job; Redis connects to it over the private network.

BACKUP_RESTORE_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds a restore may take before it is aborted (Redis is then promoted back unchanged or partially synced).
